snippet.title: Wrecked: Intro
snippet.description:
A montage of the opening moments from my desert island survival game, "Wrecked" - available to download for free from www.MDickie.com now.

For more information, you can find the game at:
http://www.mdickie.com/prev_wrecked.htm
